01-menu-basic-menu.title: Basic Menu
01-menu-basic-menu.description: A simple context menu triggered by right-click. Use this to provide quick access to common actions and context-specific commands.

02-menu-nested-menu.title: Nested Menu
02-menu-nested-menu.description: Context menu with submenus for organizing related actions. Hover over items with arrows to reveal nested options.
02-menu-nested-menu.code:
import { Menu } from 'ui-lab-components';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Menu>
      <Menu.Trigger className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-background-600 p-12 w-full cursor-context-menu select-none text-foreground-300 hover:border-background-500 transition-colors">
        Right click here
      </Menu.Trigger>
      <Menu.Content>
        <Menu.Item>New File</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item>New Folder</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Separator />
        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.SubTrigger>Open with...</Menu.SubTrigger>
          <Menu.SubContent>
            <Menu.Item>VS Code</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Sublime Text</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Vim</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Separator />
            <Menu.Item>Other Application...</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.SubContent>
        </Menu.Sub>
        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.SubTrigger>Share</Menu.SubTrigger>
          <Menu.SubContent>
            <Menu.Item>Copy Link</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Email</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Sub>
              <Menu.SubTrigger>Social Media</Menu.SubTrigger>
              <Menu.SubContent>
                <Menu.Item>Twitter</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.Item>LinkedIn</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.Item>Facebook</Menu.Item>
              </Menu.SubContent>
            </Menu.Sub>
          </Menu.SubContent>
        </Menu.Sub>
        <Menu.Separator />
        <Menu.Item>Rename</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item disabled>Delete</Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Content>
    </Menu>
  );
}

03-menu-toolbar-dropdown.title: Toolbar Dropdown
03-menu-toolbar-dropdown.description: Dropdown menu of actions with keyboard shortcuts and a disabled item.
03-menu-toolbar-dropdown.code:
import { Menu, Button } from 'ui-lab-components';
import { FaChevronDown } from "react-icons/fa6";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Menu type="pop-over">
      <Menu.Trigger>
        <Button variant="ghost">
          File <FaChevronDown className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
        </Button>
      </Menu.Trigger>
      <Menu.Content align="start">
        <Menu.Item onSelect={() => {}}>
          New file
          <Menu.Shortcut>⌘N</Menu.Shortcut>
        </Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item onSelect={() => {}}>
          Open…
          <Menu.Shortcut>⌘O</Menu.Shortcut>
        </Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item onSelect={() => {}}>
          Save
          <Menu.Shortcut>⌘S</Menu.Shortcut>
        </Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Separator />
        <Menu.Item disabled>Recent files</Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Content>
    </Menu>
  );
}

06-menu-view-options.title: View Options

07-menu-submenus.title: Submenus
07-menu-submenus.description: A pop-over menu with flyout submenus for grouping actions, including a second level of nested options.
07-menu-submenus.code:
import { Button, Menu } from 'ui-lab-components';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Menu type="pop-over">
      <Menu.Trigger>
        <Button>Open menu</Button>
      </Menu.Trigger>
      <Menu.Content align="start">
        <Menu.Item>New document</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item>Open document</Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Separator />
        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.SubTrigger>Open recent</Menu.SubTrigger>
          <Menu.SubContent>
            <Menu.Item>Project proposal</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Quarterly report</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Meeting notes</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Separator />
            <Menu.Item>Clear recent documents</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.SubContent>
        </Menu.Sub>
        <Menu.Sub>
          <Menu.SubTrigger>Share</Menu.SubTrigger>
          <Menu.SubContent>
            <Menu.Item>Copy link</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item>Email a copy</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Sub>
              <Menu.SubTrigger>Permissions</Menu.SubTrigger>
              <Menu.SubContent>
                <Menu.Item>Can view</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.Item>Can comment</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.Item>Can edit</Menu.Item>
              </Menu.SubContent>
            </Menu.Sub>
          </Menu.SubContent>
        </Menu.Sub>
        <Menu.Separator />
        <Menu.Item>Close document</Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Content>
    </Menu>
  );
}
